explication: This repository is a JavaScript generative-AI learning course, with lessons and runnable examples as its main product and a character-chat companion app as an interactive demonstration. The graph captures the documented lesson progression and major learning resources; app links are based on sampled source, while unsampled lesson implementations are represented only by their tree-supported directories.
